spans.title: Talking Through Wagner
spans.blurb: An unexpected caller sweeps in, dressed as if by a tempest, and explains why she loves loud opera: one can talk the whole time without being heard.

spans.title: The Girl in the Greenroom
spans.blurb: Fresh from a disastrous performance, an actress glows with secret joy, certain her lover will understand why she can no longer pretend on stage.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals that Dorian turns on the actress Sibyl and destroys their engagement, an early turning point in the novel.

spans.title: The Voice in Box Five
spans.blurb: At the peak of her triumph, a soprano opens her mouth and an impossible sound comes out, while two managers feel an unseen presence breathing beside them.
spans.spoilerNote: Gives away the ghost's sabotage of Carlotta and the chandelier disaster, a famous set piece the novel stages as a shock.

spans.title: The Fight with Covey
spans.blurb: Seized in a stable loft before dawn, a young man who has trembled at his tormentor's word for months discovers, mid fight, that he is done trembling.

spans.title: Eliza Crosses the Ice
spans.blurb: With slave catchers minutes behind her, a mother snatches up her child and runs for the frozen river, where broken ice heaves between her and free ground.
spans.spoilerNote: Shows that Eliza's famous escape across the river ice succeeds, defusing the novel's first great chase.

spans.title: The Halfpenny Bun
spans.blurb: A red haired young man orders his usual halfpenny bun and black coffee, then adds one more item to the order: the shopgirl's hand in marriage.

spans.title: The Mouse at Lunchtime
spans.blurb: While building a house in the woods, a man is visited each lunchtime by a wild mouse that has never seen a person before.

spans.title: A Man Against a Loon
spans.blurb: On a calm October pond, a paddler tries to outguess a diving loon whose wild laughter keeps ringing out from wherever he is not looking.

spans.title: The Man on the Tower
spans.blurb: A young governess on her evening stroll daydreams of meeting a charming stranger on the path, until her imagination suddenly turns real in the wrong place.

spans.title: The Man in the Red Sweater
spans.blurb: A kidnapped dog, caged and raging for two days, meets a calm man in a red sweater who carries a hatchet and a club.

spans.title: The Smiling Blackmailer
spans.blurb: A plump, purring gentleman with a frozen smile names his price for a lady's indiscreet letters, and no appeal, threat, or trap can shift him.

spans.title: The King of Thieves
spans.blurb: A coach tips over a cliff into a flowery hollow so soft it seems providential, and a little priest wonders aloud why they fell just there.
spans.spoilerNote: Gives away the courier Ezza's secret identity as the brigand king Montano, a mid story surprise in one of the collection's tales.
